problem: The address field is described as naming the secondary station 'for which the frame is meant'. In HDLC the address field always carries the secondary station's address, in both directions: it is the destination address on frames sent by the primary and the source address on frames sent by the secondary. In a balanced (ABM) link there is no secondary at all; the field then names one of the two combined stations.
fix: Address, 8 bits: the address of the secondary station, whether the frame is going to it or coming from it; in a balanced link it identifies one of the two combined stations. (The field can also be extended beyond one byte.)

problem: The U-frame names SNRM, SABM, DISC, UA and FRMR are used without being expanded, which an ESL reader cannot decode from the chapter.
fix: Expand them once: SNRM (set normal response mode), SABM (set asynchronous balanced mode), DISC (disconnect), UA (unnumbered acknowledgement), FRMR (frame reject).
